p.title: 거시: direction, equity impact and transmission instead of isolated numbers
p.symptom: Owner review of v57.07: the 거시 경제 tab listed values without saying whether each was good or bad, which way it was moving, or how it reached stocks; oil and gold sat at the bottom as bare prices; the '시장 위험 전이 렌즈' panel (copied from a supplied X macro-risk framework) showed BLOCKED steps and a long list of research notes that a user could not act on.
p.root_cause: The producer published only the latest print and one prior change per series, so no direction or pace could be shown; the page had no rule layer connecting indicators to equities, and the lens was a research artifact rendered on a user surface.
p.fix: Producer: refresh-data writes public-data/macro-history.json — raw FRED observations for 18 series (CPI/core CPI/PCE/core PCE indices, unemployment, payrolls, hourly earnings, retail sales, housing starts, fed funds, weekly initial claims, daily policy upper bound, 2Y, 10Y, 10Y-3M, real yield, breakeven, HY OAS); a failed series keeps its previous observations marked stale; lineage policy and staging added; placeholder shipped until the first Actions run. Domain src/domain/macro/macro-read.js: growth axis (Sahm gap >= 0.5pp or falling 3-month payroll average = 부담; Sahm < 0.3 and 3-month average >= 100k = 우호), inflation axis (core PCE >= 3.0% or re-accelerating 3-month pace = 부담; <= 2.5% and slowing = 우호), policy axis (2Y >= policy-rate midpoint + 0.25pp or real policy rate >= 2% = 부담; cuts priced with inflation not a burden = 우호); rates, oil/dollar and credit reuse the 시장 상태 axes; growth × inflation regime with its historical tendency labelled 해석; oil → breakeven → policy path → 10Y → valuation chain with dollar and credit branches, coloured by effect on stocks. Indicators get 24-month series, '1년 전 · 6개월 전' lines and direction marks; oil and gold get one-year close charts with 20-day/3-month change and 1-year range position. 금리 · 환율 gains five impact axes, the FRED 10Y-3M spread and a curve-reading guide. The transmission lens, its domain module and the bare WTI/Gold cards were retired.
p.violated_rule: Owner decisions 2026-10-01/02: judgements only by published rules with the flip condition shown; observation separate from interpretation; one source of truth across screens.
p.prevention: ci-architecture-contract-check P1426 (read markers, six hosts, lens absent, zero preserved); ci-architecture-browser-check P1426 (six macro axes in order, five chain nodes, regime label, five rates-tab axes); ci-esm-core-unit-check (Sahm gap, 3-month annualised pace, zero-base YoY guard); ci-data-lineage-audit macro-history policy.
p.verification: Local browser at 1440px with current data: policy 부담 (2Y 0.96%p above the policy midpoint — hikes priced), inflation 부담 (core PCE 3.0%, 1.0pp over target), rates/oil-dollar/credit match 시장 상태, chain shows the policy and real-yield-led 10Y links plus dollar +2.8% and HY +44bp branches. With a synthetic monthly fixture injected in the browser only: Sahm 0.35pp, payroll 3-month +20k vs +87k, claims +12% from the low, core PCE 3-month pace 3.9% → regime '성장 둔화 · 물가 상승', ten sparklines. Real macro-history arrives with the next refresh-data run (QA-MACRO-HISTORY-LIVE-01).
